caption:
Consumers feel a little better this month. 📈

The Conference Board's confidence index rose to 91.7 in October, up from 84.2 in September. It linked the lift mostly to gas prices easing.

But people still said costs are rising, and the survey shows inflation expectations at 5.8%.

Do you feel more confident, or just relieved gas dipped?
